component.name: Apertrust
component.summary: A free, non-destructive, cross-platform raw photo editor

description.p: Apertrust is a raw photo editor for people who care how their pictures look and want predictable results on their own computer. It processes photos on the GPU and builds on darktable's colour science.
Everything runs locally: no account, no cloud, no subscription. Edits are saved in a readable file beside the photo, and the original is never touched.
Apertrust is free software in early development, not yet ready for everyday use.
